sn46.44:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami ||la-pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn46.44:1.2: Duppañño eḷamūgo duppañño eḷamūgo ti bhante vuccati ||
sn46.44:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante Duppañño eḷamūgo ti vuccatī ti || || 4.
sn46.44:1.4: Sattannaṃ kho bhikkhu bojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā duppañño eḷamūgo ti vuccati || ||
sn46.44:1.7: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhu sattannaṃ bhojjhaṅgānam abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā Duppañño eḷamūgo ti vaccatī
